title: cynodon cynosuroides
intro: Cynodon cynosuroides, commonly known as Buffalo Grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. It is valued for its drought tolerance and ability to thrive in poor soil conditions. The health benefits of Buffalo Grass include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cynodon cynosuroides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
